analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($2,453.65) below SMA5 ($2,479.06), above SMA20 ($2,163.21): short-term bearish turn, mid-term bullish intact.
· Above SMA100 ($1,885.65) and SMA200 ($2,018.14): long-term trend strength solid.
· 52-week position (29.1%) + current price level historically high from lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (79.3→71.4): cooling from overbought, entering neutral.
· MACD histogram trajectory (64.3824→32.0667): improvement slowing, bullish momentum weakening.
· Bollinger Band current price position (middle line $2,163.21): consolidating around middle, no clear direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($2,443.96): based on pivot and moving averages.
· Swing resistance ($2,462.8): potential for short-term upside breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (consolidation): no trend reversal signal confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.43x): buying pressure subdued, movement reliability decreased.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation): no entry conditions met, maintaining wait-and-see.
